content_variants.text:
Drone attack | Coalition missiles hit motorcycle and car in Idlib, leaving many casualties

Idlib province: SOHR sources have reported that a drone of the International Coalition targeted an unidentified man on a motorcycle on the road to al-Mastuma in Idlib countryside with three missiles, killing him immediately. Meanwhile, a family of six, including women and children, sustained various injuries, as the car they were traveling in was passing near the site of the drone attack. The injured people were taken to field clinics in the region.

A few hours ago, SOHR sources reported that a car was attacked this morning on the road to al-Mastuma in Idlib province. However, uncertainty surrounded the circumstances and nature of the attack, as it is not known yet if the attack was carried out by drones or by explosion of an IED or a landmine. It is worth noting that reconnaissance drones of the International Coalition and others of Iranian-backed militias were seen flying over that region since early morning.
